scope: Static source review of the generated CPU-only snapshot plan builder, fail-closed admission implementation, engineering fixtures, contract and Local handoff. No generated source, test, download, inference, scorer or GPU workload was executed by Web.

findings_repaired.finding: The first draft rejected a symlink at the metadata file itself but did not reject symlinked .cache/huggingface/download parent directories, so revision evidence could resolve outside the declared snapshot root.
findings_repaired.repair: Every metadata parent is now required to be a real directory and not a symlink before the sidecar is read; the metadata file is also required to be regular and stable across the read.

findings_repaired.finding: The harness pinned the population JSON, but the first admission draft did not independently compare the exact ordered UID-list digest with the snapshot contract.
findings_repaired.repair: The contract now binds the canonical ordered UID-list SHA-256; the admission module rejects a mismatch, and the plan builder separately requires the contract's complete path/SHA-256 reference to equal the actual population file.

minor: The harness stages only the small contract, population and code references. The large external snapshot directories remain explicit absolute read-only command inputs and are bound by the resulting per-file manifest, not copied into the attempt workspace. This is suitable only for engineering staging; future scientific consumers must pin and revalidate the admitted manifest and selected bytes.

local_acceptance_required: Run the current whole-suite software acceptance at the delivered revision and record the observed method count/outcome.
Complete the existing one-UID parity/promotion/finalization chain before treating the full-population path as scientifically usable.
Download all five repositories at the contract revisions, then generate, inspect and run the exact CPU-only harness plan.
Return the native/outer receipts, logs, admitted manifest hash, five file counts/byte totals/manifest digests and any rejection without inventing replacement bytes.
Do not create a generation/timing/queue plan until snapshot admission, current device/runtime evidence and the earlier parity chain are accepted.
